name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(at_exit) clause is not expressed in the task. The sentence “If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.” only imposes a rule that the switch must be toggled before the exit when the exit is reached; it does not command the agent to reach the exit. Adding Existence(at_exit) creates an extra, unintended goal. Remove the Existence(at_exit) clause and keep only the hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) clause.

texts: The switch must be toggled before reaching the exit.
